b'# tinydl

Command Line Interface Options:

## Positional arguments

- `url`: what to download

## Options

- `-o`, `--output`: file to write (default: stdout)
- `-q`, `--quiet`: no progress output

## Example usage

```bash
# Download a URL to stdout
tinydl https://example.com

# Download a URL to a file
tinydl https://example.com -o output.html

# Download quietly
tinydl https://example.com --quiet
```
'
